elements.description: Beneficiary dimension keyed by Beneficiary ID, containing birth/death dates, sex, race, latest recorded geography, and observed summary-year range. Filters Annual Beneficiary Utilization. Latest geography is not necessarily the beneficiary's geography in an earlier year; use State and Demographic dimensions for annual breakdowns.

Claim-type dimension distinguishing inpatient Part A institutional claims from outpatient Part B institutional claims. Filters Annual Provider Claims Summary through its active relationship. Beneficiary claim-count measures also apply this selection explicitly; population and reimbursement measures do not.

Demographic dimension keyed by Demographic Key, with sex, race, age band, and display-sort columns. Filters Annual Beneficiary Utilization and Population Health Summary. Represents the demographic grouping attached to each annual summary, not a provider characteristic.

Provider dimension keyed by Provider Number, containing observed claim-year range and indicators for inpatient/outpatient claims. Filters Annual Provider Claims Summary only; the model has no provider-to-beneficiary/state/demographic attribution.

State-code dimension used to filter annual beneficiary utilization and population health summaries by the state recorded for the summary year. Codes are source-system geographic identifiers, not necessarily postal abbreviations. Does not filter provider claims.

Shared year dimension filtering beneficiary and population summaries by Summary Year and provider claims by Claim Year. Fact tables can have different year coverage; provider claims include 2007 while beneficiary summaries currently cover 2008-2010.

Annual beneficiary-level fact table at beneficiary-year grain, with annual geography/demographics, age, coverage months, condition indicators, Medicare reimbursement, and inpatient/outpatient utilization. Supports year/state/demographic/beneficiary analysis. Multi-year population averages and prevalence measures are beneficiary-year weighted; Total Beneficiaries counts distinct people. No provider relationship.

Preaggregated population-health fact table at Summary Year, State Code, and Demographic Key grain. Contains beneficiary/condition counts, averages, prevalence, reimbursement, and institutional utilization. Additive counts can be summed across disjoint groups, but averages, rates, and per-beneficiary values must be recomputed or weighted rather than summed. Does not support provider attribution.

Provider claims fact table at Provider Number, Claim Year, and Claim Type grain, containing claim/beneficiary counts, payments, cost sharing, and claim characteristics. Supports year/provider/claim-type analysis only. Beneficiary counts are not additive across providers/types/years; average columns require appropriate weighting. Coverage differs from annual beneficiary summaries, so totals need not match across all years.
